fusions.name: Sticky Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes a sticky line at an enemy up to 5 tiles away, which deals 7 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and slows it by 30% for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Swallowed Whole
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Engulfs it, which deals 22 damage and uses up every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Sink Into the Reeds
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds and restores 12 health. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Poised to Spring
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
